subject: Shapefile map in place of the default OSM map?

messages.author: 0ccfd94b538f1513
messages.subject: Shapefile map in place of the default OSM map?
parts:
Hi! 

I am new to Deducer and just trying to figure out DeducerSpatial. (The whole setup is terrific.)

Is it possible to load a shapefile into spatial plot builder in place of the default map? And then build the rest of the plot on top of that? In particular, I was wondering if I could use something like this:

http://www.naturalearthdata.com/downloads/50m-cultural-vectors/50m-populated-places/

Any advice? 

Thanks! 

-- Tony

messages.author: 267c7c6c510dc8a2
messages.subject: Re: Shapefile map in place of the default OSM map?
parts:
Hum, I'm not sure exactly what you are getting at. You can plot shape
files on top of the raster map, but there is no way to remove the
raster image from the spatial plot builder.


ian

messages.author: 143417d710ce6579
messages.subject: Re: Shapefile map in place of the default OSM map?
parts:
Hi!

I'm also new to Deducer, and incredibly relieved to find a less-intimidating way to use R.  I think I have a somewhat similar question about Deducer Spatial.  I've been able to load point, line, and polygon shapefiles with no problem, but some of the layers I was hoping to work with are raster data rather than feature data.  Is there any way to load ARC GRID, ARC ASCII, or .bil format files using Deducer Spatial?  I've seen some references that say I can use the R packages raster and rgdal to deal with these files, but I'm having trouble just getting them loaded.  Is this something Deducer can help with, or do I need to keep looking?  In either case, thanks so much for making the R learning curve a little less steep!

-Beth

messages.author: 267c7c6c510dc8a2
messages.subject: Re: Shapefile map in place of the default OSM map?
parts:
Beth,

No, this is not something that Deducer can support currently, and I'm
not aware of any R GUI which does.


ian
